label: Glass Shatter
description: A full-frame glass break. mode "break" (default): the frame fractures into triangular shards that fly outward and fall away to reveal what is behind -- a transition overlay. mode "crack": the glass cracks and HOLDS -- lines race out from an impact point (x/y), branch, web together and stay over whatever is behind (a word, a stat, a screen); nothing falls.

mode.label: "break" (shards fall away) or "crack" (cracks spread and stay)

speed.label: crack: how fast the cracks spread (1 = about half a second to the edge)

seed.label: Pattern seed (vary for a different break)
